player_prompt.intro:
Welcome to Lights Out! You have a {size}x{size} grid of lights.
Your goal is to turn ALL lights OFF (represented by '.')
When you press a light, it toggles itself AND its adjacent neighbors (up/down/left/right).
Type [row col] to press a light (0-indexed, so valid range is 0-{max_index}).
You have up to {max_turns} moves to solve the puzzle.
Legend: 'O' = light ON, '.' = light OFF

board.current_state:

invalid_move.wrong_format: An aksyon kinahanglan ha format [row col] diin an mga hilera ngan col amo an integers tikang 0 ngadto han {max_index}.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Coordinates must be between 0 and {max_index}. You entered [{row},{col}].

outcome.win: Congratulations! Gin-solbar mo an puzzle ha {moves_used} nga mga paglihok!
